title: Head of NA Operations, Professional Lines & Canada
text:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

We are seeking an accomplished operations leader to lead the operational strategy, performance and transformation agenda supporting our North America Professional Lines & Canada businesses. 
This is a senior leadership role supporting specialty insurance businesses with more than $1 billion in annual revenue and significant ambitions for continued growth. The Head of Operations will partner closely with senior Underwriting leaders to build operational capabilities that enable profitable growth, increase underwriting capacity, strengthen service and controls, and improve how we work. 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial and insurance knowledge with operational expertise and a passion for transformation. They will be equally comfortable shaping strategy with senior leaders and working with teams to understand challenges, simplify processes and turn opportunities into measurable results.

**What You'll Do** 
 

* Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior Professional Lines & Canadian Underwriting leaders.
* Translate business strategy, portfolio priorities and growth ambitions into operational priorities and capabilities.
* Build strong relationships across Underwriting and Operations to identify opportunities to improve productivity, responsiveness and the underwriting experience.
* Balance enterprise standards with the specific requirements of individual underwriting businesses.

Lead Operational Performance 

* Lead a large underwriting support organization with accountability for service, quality, productivity, capacity and operational performance.
* Establish clear performance measures and service standards across the underwriting lifecycle.
* Use data and business insight to identify root causes, resolve performance issues and continuously improve results.
* Maintain a strong operational control environment with clear ownership and accountability.

Transform How We Work 

* Lead the development and implementation of scalable target operating models that simplify work, reduce unnecessary handoffs and create underwriting capacity.
* Evaluate processes end to end and identify opportunities to improve speed, accuracy, consistency and service.
* Build compelling cases for change based on data, business impact and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure transformation initiatives move beyond implementation to deliver sustainable improvements in business performance.

Harness Technology, Data & AI 

* Partner with Technology, Data and business leaders to modernize underwriting workflows and operating practices.
* Identify and implement practical opportunities to use workflow, automation and AI to increase underwriting capacity, improve service and strengthen operational controls.
* Ensure technology investments translate into measurable business value, colleague adoption and sustainable operating improvements.

Build a High-Performing Organization 

* Build and develop a high-performing Operations organization characterized by strong business partnership, accountability, curiosity and disciplined execution.
* Develop leaders, strengthen succession pipelines and build commercial, insurance and operational capability across the team.
* Foster an inclusive environment where colleagues are encouraged to challenge existing ways of working, solve problems and improve the business.
* Align workforce and capacity plans with business demand, service expectations and anticipated growth.
* Use productivity and performance insights to guide organization design, resource allocation and investment decisions.

**What You'll Bring**

* 10+ years of progressive experience within commercial P&C insurance, including significant experience in Underwriting Operations, Underwriting Support or a closely related function.
* Significant leadership experience, including responsibility for managers and large or geographically distributed teams.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end underwriting lifecycle and the operational capabilities required to support a specialty insurance business.
* Demonstrated success partnering with senior Underwriting and business leaders and translating strategy into execution.
* Proven experience designing and implementing operating models and leading complex operational transformation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience using data to identify root causes and improve business performance.
* Experience applying technology, workflow, automation and data to improve underwriting or operational outcomes.
* Strong understanding of operational controls, service management and continuous improvement.
* A track record of leading change from concept through implementation and delivering measurable results.
* Strong commercial judgment and exceptional stakeholder-management and communication skills.
* A collaborative, hands-on leadership style, with the confidence to challenge constructively and create accountability for outcomes.
* Experience managing budgets, resources and workforce plans.
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or relevant insurance qualification preferred.

What Success Looks Like 
The successful candidate will help create a more scalable, responsive and technology-enabled operating model that: 

* Increases underwriting capacity and allows underwriters to focus more of their time on underwriting, portfolio management, broker relationships and profitable growth.
* Delivers measurable improvements in service, productivity, quality and operational control.
* Supports continued business growth without proportionate increases in cost or operational complexity.
* Converts technology, automation and AI investments into meaningful business outcomes.
* Builds a strong leadership bench and a high-performing Operations organization with clear accountability for results.

This is an opportunity to play a significant leadership role in shaping how Operations enables the next phase of growth in our North America Professional Lines & Canada businesses.

**Role Factors**

The role requires you to be in office 3 days per week. Travel may be included.

 

**What We Offer**

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $180,000 - $235,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more. Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

**This posting is for an existing vacancy.**
